school_name: La Petite Academy of Blue Springs
draft_copy:
Thank you for visiting our La Petite Academy daycare and preschool in Blue Springs, MO! Our school is located at 2010 NW State Route 7, between [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: Landmark 1] and [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: Landmark 2], a convenient setting for families in the Blue Springs community. Our academy - including care for Infants, Preschool programs and more - is nationally accredited by the National Early Childhood Program Accreditation.

Families looking for trusted child care and early education in Blue Springs, MO can find a warm, welcoming environment for their child's early learning journey. Children explore learning centers, participate in small- and large-group activities, and spend time outdoors, which gives them room to explore, build confidence, and feel comfortable from their first day.

Led by Amber Medlin, Director, our team is committed to building strong relationships with children and families. Amber says, "I have worked for La Petite Academy for seven years and have been a director on the KS side for three." Many educators have been part of our school community for [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: years of staff tenure], helping children build trusted relationships with familiar teachers.

Serving families in Blue Springs, MO for [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: years serving the community], La Petite Academy provides childcare focused on supporting children's social, emotional, and academic development. We're committed to keeping you connected throughout the day. Get access to live streaming video of your child's classroom, plus other real-time updates, with our exclusive mobile app for families, SproutAbout. Our approach helps children build the confidence and skills needed for a successful transition to kindergarten. Explore our Programs section to learn more about La Petite Academy of Blue Springs, MO.

We are here for you so please call us or stop by to schedule a tour of our La Petite Academy in Blue Springs, MO, today!
